name: Twin rails, one hub: virtual J1 on a crown rail, virtual J3 on an arm rail
family: spherical 3R (virtual J1 / J3 on arc rails)
verdict: screened (provisional, CMA-ES on the farm queued): far behind the spherical family - best honest 119.62 (score 56.5) vs the champion 68.93; the rails replace the pole hubs, which were never the limiter, and add their own: a constant-section rail must clear the highest skin anywhere on its 120-190 deg arc in any pose (crown rail 0 % in band), and the arm rail cannot cover the humeral rotation range (cov 1.0 needs 420 deg)
note: Bench(60,160), fast grid, K3 march, K2 dense, K6 (same-body pairs exempt), audit clean, rails laid out at their fitted radius (fix point). 169 configs (166 coarse on the farm + 3 local) + 1 variant-b bound. Gate (score points, variant a): gain over 2nd half 0.92, last third 0.92, top-5 spread 4.91 - NOT converged (CMA-ES streams A-D queued). Kinematics: 95 %-central carriage travels sum >= ~300 deg over 1640 valid axis sets (spec hoped +-35). Raw maps: 8 % of axis sets have a crown rail clear of the body; best constant-section crown rail 0.49 in band. Variant b (crown rail shaped per station, float not charged): gap 97.64 at the leader's axes.
limiter: crown rail constant section (rows 94-111 mm vs median skin requirement 52 mm along its 186 deg arc; set by plane 45 / elev 165 / axial -90 where the elevated arm passes under the S-fixed arc): 0 % in band; arm rail span (humeral rotation range + shoe: 297 deg at cov 0.9, 420 deg at cov 1.0) caps reach at ~0.56; overhead 2/17 taken (7 beyond the rails, 5 collisions); hub 2 0.09 and link 2 0.001 in band (the spherical family's J2 limiter is untouched)
